description.zh: 自动启用最新回源IP列表
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically enable the latest back-to-origin IP addresses list. Valid values:
- off: Do not automatically enable.
- on: Automatically enable.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。另外，站点的套餐需要支持源站防护功能。
description.en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation. The plan associated with the site must support the origin protection feature.
